scripts.ios: vite build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:live: CAPACITOR_CONFIG=capacitor.config.dev.json cap sync ios --config capacitor.config.dev.json && CAPACITOR_CONFIG=capacitor.config.dev.json cap open ios
scripts.ios:live:reset: cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.android: vite build && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.android:apk: vite build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: vite build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
